limitations: Mapped present-day land cover, not exhaustive ground truth or historical reconstruction.
20 m cell-center samples preserve polygon holes but can omit smaller features.
Unclassified is unknown, not evidence that resources are absent.
Forest does not establish tree species or quantities; quarry does not establish mineral type or remaining stock.
Game resource instances, yields and ecology remain game rules, not surveyed source facts.

alpine_vegetation.source_scope: Yushan; not a Taiwan-wide species or tree-position survey
alpine_vegetation.game_rule: Use absolute elevation, not the 0-5 gameplay levels. At or above 3600 m, forest cover produces no timber and uses sparse scrub resources; at or above 3850 m, only sparse food/herb candidates remain.
alpine_vegetation.limitation: Conservative game placement rule based on mapped vegetation belts; it does not establish surveyed trees, edible plants, medicinal properties or resource quantities.
